title: Late Winter, the Sun Stretches Warm

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a pleasant day, with the winter snow
piles giving way to warm rays
of
sunshine—the telltale signs of spring.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Wow...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spot a Tracen student looking up idly at
the sky. Maybe she's also enjoying the
sunshine? Whatever the case, I walk past
her and keep
going about my day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hm...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hah...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, how do you do? I have a spot open
next to me if you'd like.
From here, you
can see it very clearly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Look, do you see that tree over there?
Most of its leaves have fallen off, but
there is still one leaf hanging on near
the
top.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It stands alone,
gently fluttering with the
breeze. There were a few
times I thought it was going to fall off,
but it's still there all right...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She turns her gaze skyward once more.
Strangely fascinated, I somehow find
myself watching the lone leaf together
with her in
silence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gently wavering in the wind, the autumn
leaf looks like it'll be blown away at any
moment. And yet, it remains firmly
attached to its branch, defying all
expectations.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...She's a strong one, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I wasn't expecting a reply. My
apologies, I didn't realize you were
still
here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And that's why you accompanied me?
Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Bright! I finally found you—wait, who's
this?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hey... do you know this person? Don't tell
me they were trying any funny
business—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's true,
they're even wearing their badge.
Thank goodness...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She'll be fine now with her friend here,
so I
take it as my cue to leave
and bid the two
farewell.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: A trainer...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few weeks later, I spot her again on
campus. Once again, she's
staring idly at
the sky... Must be a pretty easy-going
person.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, if it isn't Provisional Trainer!
Greetings.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I've been searching for you. I
believed we would reunite
someday.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Isn't the weather just lovely today? We
had a long winter this year,
but I'm sure
spring is right around the corner.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Which reminds me, I saw that the
replanting of the school flowerbeds
has
begun. I look forward to seeing a variety
of beautiful blooms.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Provisional Trainer, what kind of flowers
do you like? As for me... I
rather adore
when small flowers are arranged closely
together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I may not know all of their names, but
seeing them getting along with
each other
is just such a heartwarming sight. Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Teehee... Oh, would you look at that. Even
the clouds in the sky are
getting along.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She continues on, talking about everything
except for the answer to my question.
Before I know it, I'm wrapped up in her
warm and fuzzy
vibes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that reminds me. From today onwards,
would you be willing to
watch over my
training sessions?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! ♪ Well then, let us
be off.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Okay, before I show you my running, I
need to stretch properly first.
Waaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, I've gotten myself wrapped up
into watching her train! While I'm still
trying to process everything,
I hear a voice suddenly
call out.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Wait... isn't that Mejiro Bright?! She's from the Mejiro family, and they say she'll be following in the footsteps of McQueen's generation!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The illustrious Mejiro family has produced
countless talented racers over the years.
Even now, it's hard to go a day without
seeing their
name in the headlines.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: For starters, I'll run 1,800 meters, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And I've just met a member of that
family—Mejiro Bright. While I originally
came here on a whim, my newfound
curiosity compels me to stay and watch her
run. But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yaaah!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Her start is that slow?! And she's not accelerating at all... You're kidding me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Whew, whooo... Oh? Provisional Trainer?
Ah, I must've run too far
past the finish
line.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
...H-how do I put it...
Her acceleration in
the final stretch wasn't great either. She
might be a Mejiro,
but I think I'll pass...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's true that her running just now
raised a few doubts. Still, when she
turned the final
bend, she was making excellent use of her
long legs. Not to mention...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
What did you think? I'm thinking of
entering the tryouts, so if you
wouldn't
mind, could you watch over my training
sessions until then?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With some more time, I'm confident I can
figure out a way to bring out her full
potential. Besides, I'm more worried about
what'll happen if I
leave her alone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Teehee, thank you very much. I've already
registered myself for the
upcoming race,
so let's make it a good one, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, was it next week? First things first,
let us have a tea party. You
can learn a lot
about someone by chatting with them over
a nice cup of tea.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, after a series of unexpected
events, I've agreed to help
Mejiro Bright
train until next week's tryouts!
